answer: An agent economy can require each identity to lock collateral before joining a market, then slash that collateral when independent counterparties expose coordinated fraud. Honest agents recover their stake and build reputation through many successful trades, while a sybil attacker must fund every fake identity separately and cannot cheaply transfer trust between them. To poison a network from zenith to nebula across a meadow of agents, the attacker therefore pays upfront capital and loses it whenever its fabricated identities are challenged.
